issues.description: The `if (!entry) return 0` guard was removed. `priceMap.get(sku)` returns `undefined` for an unknown SKU, so `entry.price` / `entry.region` throw a TypeError at runtime for any cache miss.

The added `applyTax(entry.region)` on line 12 dereferences entry.region. Even when entry is defined, a null/undefined region can make applyTax throw — a second, diff-introduced defect distinct from the removed null guard. Region's nullability is not provable from the diff, so optional.
